text:
Noah (Support): AtlasRx onboarding paused — embeddings returning near-zero vectors for several docs since 09:12 CET. They stopped ingest and flagged quality issue. Raising to CS for priority coordination, renewal check in ~11 days. :rotating_light:

Elena (CSM): Oof. Can you share an example request/response and account id so I can prep the comms? We should avoid alarming the champion before we have a plan.

Noah (Support): Account: atlasrx-007
Example:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Input: "patient note about dosage"
Response: [0.00003, 0.00001, 0.0, ...]  // ~99% zeros
```

Rashid (CS Ops): Looking at atlasrx-007: plan=trial, model_variant=embed-large-v2-quant, last_deploy=2d ago. No quota/payment flags. This looks like a model-serving/regression issue.

Priya (Product): Tagging eng — we rolled embed-large-v2-quant last week; there was a kernel swap for quant pathways. Can Eng confirm if export mismatch could yield zeroed vectors?

EngBot: Alert created ENG-8247: possible embedding vectorization regression for embed-large-v2-quant. Triage queue notified. Recommend immediate mitigation: route affected accounts to embed-large-v1-stable until fix.

Elena (CSM): Draft comms plan:
- Immediate customer note: transparent, non-alarming, offer temporary routing to stable model and a check-in call.
- Ops action: switch atlasrx-007 to embed-large-v1-stable (Rashid)
- Eng action: triage ENG-8247, prioritize rollback or hotfix (Priya/Eng)
- AE: prepare renewal impact note and offer two weeks free trial extension if needed (Sam)
Owners: Rashid -> routing change, Noah -> customer validation checks, Elena -> comms + postmortem invite, Sam -> commercial mitigation.

Sam (AE): Agreed. I'll draft an ROI/upgrade brief in case we need to frame value during recovery.

Rashid (CS Ops): Initiating routing change now, tagging action as temp-route-atlasrx-007. ETA ~8m.

EngBot: Routing change applied for atlasrx-007 at 1945001305: now using embed-large-v1-stable. ENG-8247 priority set to P1.

Noah (Support): Re-tested with customer post-route: embeddings look normal now (dense vectors, non-zero). Customer confirms they can continue ingest. They asked for explanation + assurance this won't reoccur.

Elena (CSM): Draft message to champion (will send after you confirm): "Hi <Champion> — thanks for flagging this. We found an integration regression in a recent model variant rollout that affected output for a small subset of accounts. We've routed your project to a stable variant and confirmed embeddings are healthy. We'd like 20 minutes to walk through what happened and gather any feedback. We'll also share a timeline for the fix and preventative steps. Apologies for the disruption."

Priya (Product): I'll schedule a postmortem with Eng and CS to capture root cause, customers impacted, and a rollout checklist change. Tagging product and release teams.

Sam (AE): I'll include a goodwill gesture in the comms (trial extension + dedicated onboarding slot) and update renewal owner.

Noah (Support): Customer accepted a 20m check-in tomorrow. From support POV this is unblocked; leaving thread open for CS/Eng postmortem and comms record.

Elena (CSM): Thanks all. I'll send the comms after Priya confirms PM/Eng attendance and will post the note here. Marking atlasrx-007 as "renewal_watch" until postmortem complete. :thumbsup:
